property_summary: For any nonzero fuzzed newOwner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) by the current owner must set c.owner() to exactly that address; the mutant always sets owner() to address(0), so it violates the rule.
change_summary: Replace `_transferOwnership(newOwner)` with `_transferOwnership(address(0))` so the owner is always set to the zero address instead of the requested address.
